title: TensorFlow Layer Tests artifact upload fails with ENOTFOUND on Windows runner
signature: Failed to CreateArtifact: Unable to make request: ENOTFOUND|Network

failed_jobs.name: TensorFlow Layer Tests / TensorFlow Layer Tests
failed_jobs.symptom: All pytest tests passed/skipped; job failed only because the post-test artifact upload (TEST-tf2_fe.xml, TEST-tf_fe.xml) hit a DNS resolution failure (ENOTFOUND) against the GitHub Actions artifact service

key_errors:
2026-10-10T22:23:32.4739599Z ##[error]Failed to CreateArtifact: Unable to make request: ENOTFOUND
If you are using self-hosted runners, please make sure your runner has access to all GitHub endpoints: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/hosting-your-own-runners/managing-self-hosted-runners/about-self-hosted-runners#communication-between-self-hosted-runners-and-github
root_cause: The TensorFlow Layer Tests job on the Windows self-hosted runner completed all pytest cases successfully (visible as PASSED/SKIPPED in the log), but the subsequent actions/upload-artifact step failed with a DNS resolution error (ENOTFOUND) while trying to reach the GitHub Actions artifact-upload endpoint. This is a transient network/infrastructure issue on the self-hosted Windows runner's outbound connectivity to GitHub's backend services, not a defect in the test code or the PR's actual changes (tools/ovc/openvino/tools/ovc/cli_parser.py, tools/ovc/unit_tests/ovc/utils/cli_parser_test.py), which are unrelated to TensorFlow layer testing.
reproduction_steps: N/A - not reproducible locally; this is a runner-side DNS/network failure during artifact upload on GitHub-hosted infrastructure, unrelated to the test suite or PR code.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed job (TensorFlow Layer Tests) via remediate_transient_failure or the merge-queue rerun mechanism - all underlying tests already passed
If ENOTFOUND recurs frequently on Windows self-hosted runners, escalate to the CI infra team to check runner DNS/network configuration and GitHub Actions service connectivity
No code changes needed in the PR itself
prevention_strategies: Monitor the recurrence rate of ENOTFOUND artifact-upload failures across Windows runners; if the pattern count grows significantly, consider adding retry logic around upload-artifact steps or investigating runner network/DNS health proactively.
historical_context: This exact signature (CreateArtifact ENOTFOUND, category Network) has been seen before on 2026-07-07 (PR #36738, run 28833044082) for the Python unit tests job. This is the second occurrence overall and the first on the TensorFlow Layer Tests job, confirming it is a job-agnostic, recurring self-hosted-runner connectivity issue rather than isolated to one test suite.
